title: OBS-LC-CAL-001 isotropic photon rows are pre-registered for feasibility only
question: Can a finite, candidate-neutral row set be frozen from the hash-pinned SME source without turning summary sensitivities into a likelihood or tuning the rows to a candidate?
method: Use the exact source packet hash for arXiv:0801.0287v19 and read Table S3's complete isotropic-photon subsection.
Include every listed isotropic row for operator dimensions d=3 through d=9, with source coefficient label, dimension, quoted sensitivity, units and page locator.
Declare the slice before admitting any microscopic candidate; defer matter, anisotropic photon, neutrino, gravity and data-table rows to separately versioned packets.
Permit only independent row-by-row feasibility checks and retain the source one-coefficient and conservative two-sigma order-of-magnitude semantics.
Keep likelihood, covariance, candidate map, scoring, prospective credit and physical interpretation stopped.

exact_scope.scope_boundary: T0 source-lineage and finite feasibility interface only; no candidate score, map admission or empirical validation.

checks.detail: The allowlist includes all seven rows in the Table S3 isotropic-photon subsection for d=3 through d=9; no row is selected by a candidate prediction.
Each row records its coefficient label, operator dimension, quoted sensitivity, units, and PDF page/section locator under the frozen source hash.
The packet permits only row-by-row feasibility checks and explicitly forbids a synthetic Gaussian, multiplication of rows, or independent-experiment interpretation.
No candidate has a complete F_reg/F_lim/F_eff/F_obs map, theory-error budget, scorer or acceptance rule.
The source provides summary sensitivities rather than a measurement-level joint likelihood or covariance.

finding: A seven-row isotropic photon feasibility slice is now fixed by source table, operator dimension, coefficient label, units and locator. It is a calibration interface only; no rows are combined, scored or mapped to a TECT candidate.
decision_reason: This is a bounded P1 intake advance that removes post-hoc row selection while preserving the existing forward proof method, inverse contract, source uncertainty boundary and no-promotion firewalls.

adversarial_review.check: The complete isotropic S3 subsection is included, so a later candidate cannot add or remove a row after seeing its prediction.
Conservative two-sigma order-of-magnitude sensitivities remain bounds and are never converted to Gaussian standard deviations.
Different operator dimensions are checked separately and are not treated as independent experiments or multiplied into a score.
The source Sun-centered frame, natural units and displayed dimensions are recorded per row; no silent TECT conversion is inserted.
Only an additive row allowlist and exploration record were added; no theorem order, owner contract, candidate identity or forward method was changed.

assumptions: The source packet hash identifies the exact arXiv v19 edition.
Table S3's isotropic subsection is complete for the declared d=3 through d=9 slice.
The source's one-coefficient and conservative two-sigma summary convention is retained.
Row-by-row feasibility is meaningful without inventing a joint covariance.
missing_assumptions: Measurement-level likelihood/covariance for a quantitative score.
A candidate-specific coefficient convention and complete F_reg/F_lim/F_eff/F_obs map.
A fixed theory-error, nuisance and acceptance budget.
Independent holdout data for empirical validation.
boundary: T0 P1 source-lineage and finite feasibility evidence; no theorem, physical identity, continuum or empirical result.
evidence_level: T0 source-lineage plus pre-registered finite feasibility interface
next_action: Run the existing schema and continuity checks against the allowlist, then keep candidate scoring stopped until a source uncertainty contract and all F_reg/F_lim/F_eff/F_obs stages are admitted.
stop_or_redesign: If the source hash or table semantics drift, issue a new packet version rather than mutating this record.
If a row's likelihood or covariance is unavailable, retain it as feasibility-only and exclude it from scoring.
If a candidate map is incomplete, do not select or rank a candidate from these rows.
If the complete isotropic subsection cannot be reproduced from the source locator, invalidate this allowlist and reopen the source crosswalk.
non_claims: No candidate is admitted, selected, ranked or empirically validated.
No exact Lorentz invariance, causal cone, dispersion theorem, physical vacuum or TECT dynamics is inferred.
No Pre-A, Sector-A, C6, A13, QFT, Yang-Mills, gravity, continuum, cosmic-origin, theory-of-everything or mass-gap statement is established.
The seven rows are not independent observations and do not form a joint likelihood.
